classification_and_scope: Proved class: every regular (unate, one total desirability order) function has H <= Creg Dchar, Creg=log2(4+e)+2log2(e*pi)<8.937. Includes every deterministic weighted LTF and all character multiples.
first_unproved_implication: Every Boolean function is not shown to have such an order. “Regular” does not mean small weights.

classification_and_scope: Proved class: f=F(h1,...,hm), arbitrary outer F, regular hi, H <= [11.238+(17/5)log2 m]I and H <= [11.460+(22/5)log2 m]Dchar.
first_unproved_implication: Arbitrary representation with bounded m, or removal of its log m cost. Taking hi=xi has m=n and does not give an absolute constant.

classification_and_scope: Proved class: unate gates with at most w desirability chains; add log2 w to T01 and to the T02 coefficients.
first_unproved_implication: Bounded width for all functions, or paying the width term independently of w. Singleton chains only yield w=n.

classification_and_scope: Proved class: a Boolean labeling of one linear score with at most m transitions has ordinary coefficient 11.238+(12/5)log2 m and T02's centered consequences.
first_unproved_implication: Uniformly bounded transitions for an arbitrary seed, or new payment for growing m.

classification_and_scope: Proved class: fixing k specified bits leaves regular restrictions; represent using those k literals and 2^k regular restrictions, so T02 gives O(k+1) coefficient.
first_unproved_implication: Bounded k for arbitrary functions. Restrictions of a class remain in that class; the converse universal representation is unpaid.

classification_and_scope: Proved class: union/intersection of arbitrarily many outer gates, each a combination of <=M regular functions, each physical variable relevant to <=k outer gates. H <= [41+7log2 k+(29/5)log2 M]I; H+ <= [132+(118/5)log2 k+(106/5)log2 M](I-v). Chains add log2 w to ordinary coefficient, 2log2 w to FEI+ coefficient.
first_unproved_implication: Uniformly controlled k,M,w or payment replacing their logarithms. General coherent outer composition is not this theorem.

classification_and_scope: One-way sufficient: a valid fixed queue reference and complete finite witness yield H <= h2(v)+v Lambda+sum_(A!=empty) P_f(A) min C(A).
first_unproved_implication: A representation/reference/witness choice with the complete residual <=K I uniformly, retaining roots, subset normalizers, ranks, attachments, child counts and labels.

classification_and_scope: Proved class: ordinary addressing has H=2a, I=1+a/2; the queue code gives H<10I, exact spectrum H=4(I-1).
first_unproved_implication: Extension of the whole-set payment to every Boolean spectrum. Addressing alone does not do this.

classification_and_scope: Proved biased gate class: every symmetric threshold under every product law has corrected H_mu+ <= CT (I_mu-Var_mu), CT=80+460/ln2<744. Deterministic inputs are frozen/deleted.
first_unproved_implication: Weighted thresholds under arbitrary biases are not covered; see T15.

classification_and_scope: One-way composition theorem: disjoint input blocks, gate at the actual induced independent output biases, every constituent corrected FEI+ coefficient <=C implies composed coefficient <=C. a_i=I_i(g)/v_i, entropy and deficit both split with these weights.
first_unproved_implication: A uniform gate inequality at all reached biases. Overlapping blocks have coefficient collisions; independent clones do not justify identifying occurrences.

classification_and_scope: Proved formula classes: read-once symmetric-threshold/parity formulas under arbitrary product laws, arbitrary depth/fan-in/negations, coefficient CT. Uniform full H<=744I and H<=747(I-v). AND/OR/parity have their separate smaller elementary gate constants.
first_unproved_implication: Every Boolean function does not have a read-once realization by this basis with the same physical inputs.

classification_and_scope: Proved hybrid classes: disjoint uniform LTF terminal blocks; internal symmetric thresholds/parity at arbitrary means; arbitrary weighted LTF internal gates only with balanced nonconstant children; fixed-arity other gates with their established induced-bias constants. Coefficient is the maximum gate constant.
first_unproved_implication: Remove the balance condition only after proving weighted biased FEI+, and separately pay physical variable reuse.

classification_and_scope: Proved balanced/mixed classes: read-once regular or character-regular gates, all nonconstant outputs below root balanced, H<=4Creg(I-v). More generally use 4Cm for T02 gates, T06's FEI+ coefficient, corresponding chain corrections, and unrestricted-bias symmetric thresholds/parity elsewhere.
first_unproved_implication: Unbalanced internal regular gates need a new induced-bias theorem; growing gate parameters must stay in the maximum.

classification_and_scope: One-way conversion: uniform H+<=C(I-v) gives H<=max(C,log2 e)I and H<=(C+eta)(I-v), eta<2.553.
first_unproved_implication: The universal corrected FEI+ premise is unpaid; discarding the empty atom without this conversion is invalid.

classification_and_scope: Open class-extension target: absolute biased corrected FEI+ for every weighted LTF, uniformly in arity/weights/biases.
first_unproved_implication: Precisely the displayed weighted-bias inequality. If proved it expands disjoint formula classes; no arbitrary-variable-reuse reduction to full FEI is established.

classification_and_scope: Proved selector identities/closure: cells partition independent controls; leaves balanced with pairwise disjoint nonempty Fourier supports. H=H(p)+sum pj[H(qj)+H(gj)], I=Dsel+sum pj I(gj). Affine cells codimension cj, dual-coordinate support rj give H=2sum pj cj+sum pj H(gj), I=(1/2)sum pj rj+sum pj I(gj).
first_unproved_implication: Arbitrary cells' internal normalized spectrum or colliding leaf supports remain unpaid. Physical data blocks may overlap only under the stated Fourier separation.

classification_and_scope: One-way/class closures under T16 hypotheses: H(hj)<=Cs I(hj), H(gj)<=Cg(I(gj)-1) give H(F)<=max(Cs+4,Cg)(I(F)-1). Corrected cell FEI+ improves coefficient to max(Cs,Cg,4). Affine cells use max(4,Cg).
first_unproved_implication: The cell and leaf bounds with a common finite constant, plus separation, must be established. Removing these hypotheses silently inserts an arbitrary seed.

classification_and_scope: Proved shared-data class: fresh a-bit uniform selector, arbitrary common-data branches. Exact H=average H(gb)+a+sum RT[H(nuT)-H(rT)]; H<=average H(gb)+2a. If I_sel>=c a and branches H<=C I, conclude H<=max(2/c,C)I. Neighbor orthogonality gives c=1/2.
first_unproved_implication: A dimension-free positive c in a new class, or paying full collision cost when I_sel/a tends to zero. The 2a bound is not itself an influence payment.

classification_and_scope: Proved recursive class: fresh selector coordinates absent from both branches; neighboring branches orthogonal at each node; regular leaves; arbitrary depth/data reuse; H<=Creg I. R's earlier cor:thresholdmux gives the same type of threshold closure.
first_unproved_implication: Arbitrary functions are not shown to admit this orthogonal fresh-selector hierarchy. Reused controls require a new proof.

classification_and_scope: Equivalence with the same optimal constant: all two-cell selectors Mg for balanced arbitrary g versus full FEI.
first_unproved_implication: A uniform bound for the arbitrary-core selector class itself. Cheap label entropy alone does not pay cell entropy.

classification_and_scope: Equivalence with the same optimal constant: for every fixed eps,delta>0, point activations of arbitrary balanced cores with 0<I<=eps and Pr(F=-1)<=delta have supremum C_FEI.
first_unproved_implication: The arbitrary balanced-core bound; rarity does not decrease the optimal constant.

classification_and_scope: Equivalence with the same optimal constant: for each fixed eps>0,k>=0, simultaneously I<=eps, EF>=1-eps, max_i I_i/Var<=eps, and spectral-support distance>k retain supremum C_FEI. A stronger construction has distance>2k and all <=k-bit restrictions preserve H and mean and remain in the class.
first_unproved_implication: A uniform FEI estimate on that actual Boolean class; finite-depth plateaus and diffuse influences do not remove arbitrary seed difficulty.

classification_and_scope: Equivalence, including R01 conditions, with additional I<=2^(-s(N)) for any fixed nonnegative s(N)=o(N), N final dimension.
first_unproved_implication: Uniform estimate at that subexponential scale. The known fixed linear exponent cN class is different and does not supply it.

classification_and_scope: One-way sufficient endpoint J: for each f choose an admissible gate union/ordered covers, one global feasible positive lambda vector and conditional laws on distinct actual partition-forest runs; residual R_f<=K I with one finite universal K implies C=2+Kref+K.
first_unproved_implication: The residual inequality itself. Existence of finite covers/runs is insufficient. No reverse implication for this restricted reference family or equality of optimal constants is proved.

classification_and_scope: Proved fractional structured estimate: H<=C0 I+(48/5)sum alpha_j log2 S_j(lambda)+v log2 Z, C0<41; S_j=sum_(l,t) sqrt(q_jlt) M_l^(5/48)lambda_l^(-11/48). q is from disjoint physical signed pivotal pieces, gates combine regular inner gates. Outer-only estimate retains its sum of sqrt(q_jl)lambda_l^(-11/48).
first_unproved_implication: Uniformly bound the complete influence-weighted logarithmic sum under a constructive cover and global feasible weights. The local Renyi half order here is not a bound on full spectral Renyi entropy.

classification_and_scope: One-way hereditary induction: restriction-closed class, every nonconstant member has relevant i with Delta_i H<=C I_i, then H<=C I. Threshold cutoff I_i>=tau gives coefficient kappa(tau)/tau by the scalar profile.
first_unproved_implication: Existence of such a uniformly paid split at every reached nonconstant member. FEI alone is not claimed here to imply a same-constant Delta selection.

classification_and_scope: Equivalence in finiteness: exists K finite, for every nonconstant Boolean f exists relevant i with B_i(f)<=K I_i(f). FEI(C) implies selection with K=C; selection(K) implies FEI(K+2/ln2).
first_unproved_implication: Proving any finite universal K. The quantifier is exists i, not every i or maximum-influence i. Optimal constants are not identified.

classification_and_scope: One-way tree/block criterion: actual adaptive physical restrictions; expected full path decrements plus terminal H paid by root influence. Block decrement = conditional spectral erasure + channel term, channel <=(2/ln2) I_W; influence telescope exact. A bound on cumulative erasure by K times queried influence plus leaves with constant L gives max(K+2/ln2,L).
first_unproved_implication: A measurable proper-block/stopping rule with uniform cumulative payment and certified leaves. W=all inputs returns H as the purported erasure payment.

classification_and_scope: One-way centered induction: at each nonterminal noncharacter node choose i with Delta_i H<=C d_i^D, where d_i^D=Dchar-parent average Dchar(children)>=min(I_i,1-I_i); telescopes to H<=C Dchar.
first_unproved_implication: The selection bound. If max I_i<=1/4, d_i^D=I_i at every split; centering has no gain there.

classification_and_scope: Exact FEI equivalence at fixed constant C: a symmetric nonnegative finite Gamma on dyadic probabilities, Gamma(1/2)<=C, satisfies Gamma(pout)+H_nu(G)<=sum_i I_i^nu(G)[Gamma(pi)+h2(4pi(1-pi))]/[4pi(1-pi)] for every finite Boolean gate and every interior dyadic bias vector.
first_unproved_implication: Construct and prove Gamma independently of FEI. Defining Gamma_C by an infimum of C I-H assumes its nonnegativity from the desired FEI statement. No extension to all real biases is established.

classification_and_scope: One-way encoder inference: unbiased encoders of prescribed dyadic output biases allow raw composition with coefficients R_C(g)=[C I(g)-H+(g)]/Var(g). Conjunction encoders have R_C=2+[C/(2(1-p))-2]log2(1/p).
first_unproved_implication: Uniform control of encoder slack is absent; if C exceeds a valid C0, every encoder incurs a logarithm at rare p. Uniform FEI does not automatically prove biased FEI+ by this substitution.

classification_and_scope: Failed transfers, not sufficient conditions: all-coordinate local charge, maximum-I or maximum-dD split, separable influence potentials with O(t) near zero, and variable cloning followed by diagonal identification.
source_locator: restrictions.tex prop:bentsplice, cor:badmaximum, prop:separablepotential; conclusion.tex prop:cloning
first_unproved_implication: These edges are refuted at their precise scopes. The independent-clone majority example has clone H,I->0 while identified majority has H>=2. No universal diagonal entropy transfer is available.

classification_and_scope: One-way abstract encoding: rooted refinement forest, branching <=b, terminal capacity <=M, entropy bounded by root entropy plus expected occupied masks and leaf contents.
first_unproved_implication: For arbitrary Boolean spectra, a hierarchy whose entire expected occupancy cost is O(I); the mask chain rule alone has no such bound.

classification_and_scope: Proved conditional geometric criterion: four-arm quasi-multiplicativity/fixed-factor regularity, pi4(u,t)>=c(u/t)^(2-eps), location-uniform bulk four-arm upper comparison and half-plane three-arm bound C(r/t)^beta with beta>1 yield H(S),H(P)<=C m(R). Additional I>=c m(R) gives influence upper bounds; biases bounded away from endpoints give H(S)<=C J.
first_unproved_implication: The geometric assumptions and lower influence comparison do not hold by definition for arbitrary Boolean functions. Removing them is a new theorem.

classification_and_scope: Proved class: bounded-aspect critical square-bond rectangles and triangular-site rectangles with px in [p,1-p], p in [p0,1/2], R<=L_eta(p). H(S) comparable to J, H(P) comparable to physical I, uniform in location/profile with constants depending on fixed p0,eta,aspect/lattice conventions. Nonroot retained-scale entropy comparable to m(R)/m(s). Fair inputs give FEI.
first_unproved_implication: An embedding of arbitrary Boolean signs into these crossings with a paid ratio-preserving ledger is not supplied. Small R outside the cutoff can be separately handled by bounded finite dimension for fixed conventions.

classification_and_scope: Proved LOWER bounds: monotone pivotal H(P)+H(f conditional on P)>=sum h2(pi)I_i; uniform H(P)>=I-1. Local guards of bounded size and overlap force exponential spectral-atom upper bounds, hence entropy LOWER bound.
first_unproved_implication: Neither is an entropy upper bound. Equal one/two-coordinate marginals of spectral and pivotal sets do not transfer their full Shannon entropies.

classification_and_scope: Proved conditional singularity criterion: uniform local Fourier coercivity under every exterior operator, bounded disjoint-block coloring, spectral tested size escaping, and comparison laws forbidding the local pattern yield discrete asymptotic singularity.
first_unproved_implication: This is not an FEI route. General Jordan-quad singularity does not assert general-quad entropy; microscopic separation does not establish continuum singularity.
